name: Long Road Home
source: Long Road Home It is a story about the journey of a man who is released from physical prison but is still imprisoned within his mind by events of his past. He is searching to fill the void from the loss of the life he had before being imprisoned. His search puts him in the cross hairs of two warring outlaw biker clubs. Would being accepted by one of the clubs replace the family he lost? Will he perform the tasks to gain acceptance into the club?​
translation: 《漫漫回家路》讲述了一个男人从肉体监狱中释放出来，但仍然被过去的事件囚禁在他的脑海中的旅程的故事。他正在寻找填补因入狱前失去的生活而产生的空虚。他的搜索使他成为两个交战的亡命之徒俱乐部的焦点。被其中一家具乐部接纳会取代他失去的家人吗？他会完成任务以获得俱乐部的认可吗？​
